text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day like any other, while Mejiro
Ardan and I
are training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Whew... It appears as though we're nearing the end of today's session.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Little by little, I'm beginning to
feel the
fruits of these exercises out on
the track.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However, perhaps it's my mindset that's
truly
changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was so desperate to defy fate, I
daresay my
practice sessions were more
akin to last-ditch
struggles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Whereas now, I feel as if I am steadily
moving
forwards, planting my feet more
and more firmly
as I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, perhaps a brief run is in
order?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Calmly, earnestly, and steadily. Off
I go,
then.
